???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "What must every Vortex optimization preserve, under the optimizer's contract?"

        The program's observable behavior: every byte it prints, whether and where it stops with a runtime error, and its exit status, on every input. Everything else, such as timing or register choice, is free to change.

        Introduced in [O1. The optimizer's contract](o1-optimizer-contract.md).

    ??? question "What do we call a situation where the rules say nothing about what happens next, and can a well-formed v0.1 program reach it?"

        Undefined behavior. Vortex v0.1 does not intentionally expose it to well-formed programs.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 9. Runtime safety](../compiler/guide/stage-9-runtime-safety.md). Specification: [1. Conformance and terminology](../specification/conformance.md#15-undefined-behavior).

    ??? question "What kind of rule, such as an index being inside its array, depends on values known only while the program runs?"

        A dynamic rule. Unless the compiler can prove the answer, it keeps a runtime check for it.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 5. Types and language rules](../compiler/guide/stage-5-types-and-rules.md). Specification: [1. Conformance and terminology](../specification/conformance.md#14-static-and-dynamic-rules).
